# Interactive CLI contract (add, init) - decided 2026-11-23, owner-approved direction

When prompts run
- stdin AND stderr are terminals and output is text: prompts.
- --format json, or stdin or stderr not a terminal: never prompt. add without flags -> E214; init without --yes -> E240; each names the flags to pass.
- Blank or whitespace --summary: error before any prompt.

Ending a run
- Completed: path written; next-step line on stderr; exit 0.
- Esc or Ctrl-C at any prompt: "Cancelled, nothing written."; exit 130.
- Declining the review / write confirmation: "Cancelled, nothing written."; exit 0.
- Editor saves nothing or exits non-zero: "Cancelled, nothing written."; exit 0.
- External kill -INT at a prompt: default signal behaviour (signal 2), nothing written; documented limit: terminal may need `reset`.
- SIGINT while $EDITOR runs (unix): ignored by Callisto (git launch_editor precedent); the editor decides. No signal thread anywhere.

Editor and inputs
- $VISUAL else $EDITOR; blank = unset; none -> inline summary prompt.
- Unusable editor (split error, not found, non-UTF-8): one warning naming the variable and command, then the inline prompt, answers kept.
- Whitespace-only inline summary: re-prompt.
- Changed packages first and ticked, exactly as status reports; detection failure -> one warning, all unticked.
- JSON mode: exactly one report on stdout; notes once on stderr.

init and origin
- Missing or non-hosted origin: one note; preview and init continue unbound; the remote value is never printed.
- --workflow / --artifact-target without a hosted origin: E299, help names git remote get-url --push origin / set-url --push.

Exit codes: 0 success or decline; 1 error; 2 usage; 130 cancelled at a prompt.

Proposed additions (2026-11-24, pending owner approval)
- TERM=dumb never prompts (E214/E240), as non-TTY.
- While init prompts, its facts and preview go to stderr so the user sees what they confirm.
- Ticking no packages in add re-asks instead of E273.
Accepted limits (documented, not built): resize mid-prompt redraws on the next key; the editor temp file can leak if the terminal is closed while the editor is open.

Rendering (decided 2026-11-24)
- Callisto does no terminal sizing and never rewrites labels: full package names are shown and filtered; inquire's default page size; inquire wraps long labels.
- Documented limits of the prompt library: resizing mid-prompt or a pane under about 10 rows can misdraw; use a bigger pane or pass --package/--summary.
